name: DukaanOS
summary: A complete offline shop management system for local shopkeepers. Manage sales, stock, customers and more — without internet.
problem: Small shops lose track of stock and daily sales on paper registers, and most POS tools stop working without a stable internet connection.
contribution: Designed the data model, built the full desktop UI and implemented the local SQLite persistence layer.

name: BIN SALEH Store
summary: A modern e-commerce platform with product categories, cart and a secure checkout experience.
problem: A local clothing retailer needed an online storefront to sell beyond walk-in customers and manage products without a developer.
features: Product catalogue with categories and search
contribution: Built the storefront UI, the REST API for products and orders, and the admin dashboard.

name: Portfolio Website
summary: A responsive and modern portfolio website to showcase my skills, projects and services.
problem: Clients and recruiters needed one clear place to understand what I build and how to reach me.
contribution: Designed and developed the entire site, front to back.
